rationale: Independent PO review conducted for task_v41_validation_scenario_1. Delivery is functionally sound — the test e2e validates the full chain publish → relay v4.1 → launcher → COMPLETED. CI is green (Lint+Typecheck+Test PASS, CodeQL PASS across all categories). All core acceptance criteria from issue #697 are met. The relay v4.1 correctly implements RPOPLPUSH for no-loss guarantee (fixing the v4 gap). The launcher uses SET NX compare-and-swap for safe claim handling. The protocol schema v1.0.0 is clean and well-structured. 4 observations require follow-up tickets (1 HIGH security, 2 MEDIUM robustness/testing, 1 LOW quality). Process chain was violated (merge without prior independent PO review).

task_id_stable_retrouvable.evidence: test_scenario1_e2e.py:47 — task_id hardcoded 'task_scenario1_001', assertions verify persistence via task_key (line 126) and result_key (line 137). Protocol v1.0.0 enforces task_id in message schema (fleet_protocol.py:117).

sequence_received_to_completed.evidence: RECEIVED ✓ (queue length=1, line 85-89). ACCEPTED ✗ (tautological assertion on line 154 — 'relay.returncode is not None' is always True for any completed subprocess, even non-zero exit). STARTED not explicitly checked — relay v4.1 does log 'PROCESS' and 'LAUNCH' events but test doesn't capture them. COMPLETED ✓ (inbox state=COMPLETED verified on line 114-122).

resultat_consultable.evidence: fleet_launcher.py:334 — result_key(task_id) SET with TTL 86400. Test line 137 verifies GET on result:<task_id> returns persisted result with state=COMPLETED.

reversible_sans_effet_externe.evidence: Hardcoded 'Sans effet externe': True on line 157/165. No real assertion that task produces no git/file/network side effects. Task body is declarative ('[TEST SCENARIO 1] Tâche sans effet externe') but not verified programmatically.

positives: Protocol v1.0.0 with explicit schema versioning — clean separation of transport states (PUBLISHED/CLAIMED/DELIVERED) and business states (ACCEPTED/RUNNING/BLOCKED/COMPLETED/FAILED/CANCELLED)
Atomic RPOPLPUSH in relay v4.1 (line 243) prevents message loss — fixes the critical v4 gap between BRPOP and ACK
TaskClaim with SET NX compare-and-swap for safe release via Lua script (fleet_launcher.py:111-123) — avoids race conditions on claim handoff
Injection-safe --query-file input in launcher (line 158) — no shell interpolation, prevents command injection via task body
Structured logging with UTC timestamps across all components for traceability
Pre-test cleanup of Redis keys (lines 51-55) ensures reproducibility
Graceful subprocess execution with timeout and stderr capture (relay_v4_1.py:159-185)
Recovery test validates crash scenarios with real relay subprocess lifecycle (test_recovery.py)

observations.description: Redis password hardcoded in test source code — exposed in version control and PR diff
observations.recommendation: Mandatory REDIS_PASS env var with no default fallback; if missing, fail immediately with clear error message. Remove hardcoded default value.

observations.description: Assertion 'relay.returncode is not None' is always True for any completed subprocess (even if exit code is non-zero). This does not verify actual relay success.
observations.recommendation: Replace with 'relay.returncode == 0' to verify actual relay success. Consider also checking relay stderr for error indicators.

observations.description: Default REDIS_HOST=172.16.12.2 and REDIS_PASS='' hardcoded with silent fallback — could mask misconfiguration in production
observations.recommendation: Fail-fast on missing required config in production mode; remove silent defaults or require explicit opt-in for test mode.

observations.description: 'Sans effet externe': True hardcoded — no real assertion that task produces no side effects
observations.recommendation: Assert no git changes (git status --porcelain), no file writes outside test/tmp directories, no network calls outside Redis. Add as follow-up ticket.
